description: Post-AQ baseline. Wave 1-3 fully landed (self-hosting closure deferred per Phase 1.2 fallback). Wave 4 partial: Vec sizing landed; CSS L4 routing + key dispatch hash reverted (regression).

bbnf_workspace.diff_vs_post_ap: 30 new failures vs post-AP's 'all passing' baseline. Breakdown: 8 css tape-parity/bench panics (CSS L4 grammar now chokes at comment+declaration boundaries), 4 closure_* pipeline tests (grammar closure feature deferred per Phase 1.2), 4 css_* tape_parity parses, 2 lower_* (cyclic meta), 2 ir_meta_* (follow + memo/span labels), 2 recover (parse_recover_directive/without_terminator), 2 gorgeous dumps (dump_biome_vs_gorgeous, dump_tailwind_comparison), 2 hint_* (indent/softbreak), 2 lsp analyze (cycle/alias detection), 2 diagnostics (alias hint, cycle path), 1 google_sheets let_parses_as_let_call, 1 pipeline_google_sheets_multiline_let, 1 compile_request_rejects_unknown_nonterminal, 1 no_hand_written_subvariant_references, 1 test_selective_transitive_unfurling, 1 output_size_comparison. Root causes: CSS grammar regression from AQ.1-6 refactors (structural dispatch delete + RegexClass/scanner deoverfit), IR meta label emission changes, closure feature partial rollback.

bootstrap.context: fails at `body { margin: 0; font-family: var(--bs-body-font-family); ... }` block following `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`; offset lands on an empty-line/comment boundary before the body rule

normalize.context: fails right after the opening comment block `/* ... Prevent adjustments of font size after orientation changes in iOS. */` before `html { line-height: 1.15; ... }`

tailwind.context: fails at an early stylesheet boundary (offset 340)

phases: AQ.1 (self-hosting closure — partial: regen failed, span-text fallback restored)
AQ.6.B+C+D (aggregate layout + Alt typed enum + cleanup)

deferred_work: Bootstrap regen without span-text fallback (Phase 1.2): requires deeper architectural change to handle sub-variant compounds vs. typed view accessors.
CSS L4 identifier kernel routing (AQ.7.2): scan_ident does not handle CSS escape sequences (\\.) — classifier needs to reject patterns mixing identifier shape with escape branches.
Length-bucketed perfect hash for key dispatch (AQ.7.3): worktree implementation regressed CSS L4 — needs distinct test coverage for hash collision behavior.
skip_space bitmap caching (AQ.8.1): ws_bitmap already exists in ParserState; nospace_bits/nospace_start additions need careful integration with existing cache.
TLS-recycled scratch (AQ.8.3): optional codegen flag — deferred.
NEON simd_str2int (AQ.8.4): current SWAR 8-digit chunks already fast — ROI low.
AQ.9.2 samply diff (this run): too time-consuming for the sweep; follow-up profiling pass.
AQ.9.3 BBNF_EGRAPH_REPORT / BBNF_CSP_REPORT release emission: env-var hooks exist but reporting is dormant.

CSS L4 benchmark parse regression: bootstrap/normalize/tailwind all fail before emitting timing — root cause not yet isolated but correlates with the AQ.1-5 structural dispatch delete + scanner deoverfit work; the revert in 64a2cf9 did not fully restore bench-side parsing.

post_aq_status.code_quality: Codebase has shed 5 nominal RegexClass variants (JsonString/JsonNumber/CssIdent/CssQuotedString/WsBlockComment), 7 sp_*/sp_* SpanParser constructors, deleted the entire structural dispatch infrastructure, deleted PayloadKind, generalized TypeDesc to full integer suite, and consolidated 5 IR-walking primitives into a shared inspect module.
post_aq_status.test_health: 30 failing tests against a clean workspace run (563 passing, 5 ignored). CSS L4 parsing regressed across all three bench datasets (bootstrap/normalize/tailwind) with Syntax errors at early boundaries — needs isolation and fix in a follow-up tranche. JSON monolithic and compile_pipeline benches are healthy.
post_aq_status.self_hosting: generated.rs still hand-maintained. Bootstrap regen path produces a divergent generated.rs because the codegen inlines single-use sub-rules even under preserve_identity. Resolution requires the deeper architectural change.
